capture_evidence.rtmr_replay_rule: RTMR[i] = SHA-384(RTMR[i] || event_digest) per TCG2 crypto-agile CCEL record, index 1-4 -> RTMR0-3; EV_NO_ACTION never extended; MRTD (index 0) is TDX-module measured, no event extends it. Source: gm-miner/attestd/src/eventlog.rs.
capture_evidence.initdata_toml_match: The pinned initdata SHA-384 corresponds to exactly ONE local file: nim/eastwest/initdata-imagegen.toml (sha384 computed 2026-11-24 = 0484a58e...). No other initdata-*.toml carries it (dsv4=9274dfc6, external-dns=3284a5aa, firecrawl=e1661fad, gamma-funder=8a6c47db, glm=4d113ffb, imagegen-incluster=7f7b2ab8, litellm=c480c598, nim=5175eee8, recycler=a8f5d67b). So the image-gen backend class has exactly one measured InitData identity.

capture_blockers._note: RESOLVED 2026-11-25. The five TDX launch registers (MRTD + RTMR0-3) are now CAPTURED from the booted guest's hardware quote + CCEL replay (see measurements._capture). Retained as provenance for why a host-side path was never viable and how the capture was unblocked.
capture_blockers.why_host_side_was_blocked: MRTD is computed by the TDX module from the OVMF/initial-TD content with hardware-specified ordering that is not the naive OVMF+kernel+append concatenation; RTMR0-3 are zero at launch and are extended ONLY by in-guest TDG.MR.RTMR.EXTEND calls logged in the guest CCEL event log. Neither is a pure function of the host-side launch argv. The measured agent policy denies ExecProcessRequest, so no kubectl-exec path reaches the loopback /aa/evidence either.
capture_blockers.root_cause_of_initial_404: CoCo's in-guest Get-Attestation (GET 127.0.0.1:8006/aa/evidence) is DISABLED by default and gated behind the guest kernel parameter agent.guest_components_rest_api=all. The first canary booted without it -> /aa/evidence 404 -> the /kubetee/evidence route failed closed. The SNP gateway manifest carries this flag (why its evidence worked). FIXED by adding agent.guest_components_rest_api=all to the io.katacontainers.config.hypervisor.kernel_params annotation (this is why RTMR1 carries it).
capture_blockers.recomputation_tool_gap: The reference launch-measurement tool sev-snp-measure supports ONLY AMD SEV/SEV-ES/SEV-SNP modes; it has no Intel TDX MRTD mode. Rather than reconstructing registers from launch inputs, this record reads MRTD/RTMR0-3/MRCONFIGID from the hardware quote and cross-checks RTMR0-3 by CCEL replay (gm-miner/attestd/src/eventlog.rs) — the captured-and-replayed bar the SNP gateway record set.

report_data._surface_note: This binding is the v1 contract as defined for the SNP gateway role. The nim-terminator backend evidence surface is DEPLOYED and was used for the capture: GET /kubetee/evidence (and /v1/kubetee/evidence for the LiteLLM gateway relay path) on the in-guest strict-mTLS :8443 listener returns {quote, cc_eventlog, keyset, bindings, tee_pubkey, signature} with the epoch statement (epoch_id/issued_at/valid_until/keyset_digest) minted at most once per 5 minutes per replica and cached in the serving guest's memory, plus a per-request signature over sha256(quote)||sha256(nonce)||epoch_id||counter with the per-epoch Ed25519 tee-pubkey. A nonce-bound quote (report_data binding the caller's nonce directly) is available at 1 per 5 minutes per client key. The epoch-statement form is what the 2026-11-25 capture exercised (report_data = sha256(epoch statement)||32 zero bytes, verified). See CLIENT-FACING-ATTESTATION.md 'Backend evidence for nim-terminator'.
